open: Giver is unresolved. 9000000226 is shared with Basic Combat Tutorial and the chain table says no regional tutorial giver exists for it, so npc_id is null here. The earlier answer's wiring of it is rejected.

'Use ultimate' needs a split use kind the builder does not have. 'Tough Gloamling' (441462) is only a text match to the objective and is not a verified kill target. The Super Attack, energy potion and health potion steps named in the A2 guide row have no verified locale ids here and are not listed.
Rewards: the 5-coin value is a reconstructed fallback (R) with no source, so rewards is empty. The chain table's 5 coins is not evidence.
Dialog offer, progress and complete ids are not identified. The Hero's Journal strings 4419558-4419562 belong to the next quest, and I drop the earlier 'same client block' claim.
Live status could not be independently confirmed. The video attestation (3caQP-As968/00306-00318) was not re-checked here, and no wiki or article page covers the quest.

open: The giver is only a repo label 'Darkthorne (fight)' with no locale name; whether Darkthorne or Pappy Farnum speaks the offer is unknown. The complete line 4419565 is presumed Pappy Farnum's, not stated by the line.
The defend step has no count in the client. Its target (the Gloam defenders) is undefined in field_enemies, and the repo's encounter 411 wiring is our own choice, not original data.
The six globe/barrier strings are client-only. Their sequence and relation to the defend step are not confirmed by any source.
Talk string 4419612 is not client-tagged to this quest; identical strings 4420039 and 4420087 belong to other quests.

Reward: the 25 coins in the earlier opening script conflicts with the chain table's 3 coins; I kept 3 and did not confirm either against an original source. The guide's video /00424 cited for the reward is not checked.
Zone is Farnum Farmstead from the giver record. The Gloam cave (Briarwood Caverns) is supported only by the guide and native-run notes, not by a wiki page or article.
Record must stay disabled until 9000000068 resolves to a named NPC and the Gloam defenders are defined in field_enemies.

q3000005.title: Saving Farnum's Farm

line.name: Farnum's Farmstead opening arc (Adventurer Part A, guide row A5)

objectives.text: Fill the water bucket
Put out the fires
Return to Pappy Farnum

rewards.source: notes/Build Guides/Content/Jobs/Adventurer.md row A5; video /00526 (guide only, no client reward string found)

open: Cooking 101 is NOT placed as the next quest. The client hand-off 4420049 names Mae, not Cooking 101. The repo's Cooking 101 record is 3050004 in chef.json, with an unresolved giver (Auguste Frydaze is only a guess) and no link to 3000005. Chef.md row E4 gives its location as unknown. The play-test log shows Cooking was still unaccepted after the turn-in, so the order is unsettled.

Farming 101 (3000006) is next only by repo prerequisite. Its repo giver is 9000000396, but the dossier and video /00526 say Pappy offers it through 'Go talk to Mae Farnum'. Resolve the giver before wiring.
The Last Best Hope (3000004) is linked by prerequisite and guide row order only. Its repo giver is 9000000068, not Pappy 9000000165. Resolve before treating it as a Pappy hand-off.

Fire objective: 5100043 'Put out the fires' is the text, and the count of 3 comes from the guide's '0/3' note, not from a client count field. No interaction kind or target id exists for the fires, so the record stays disabled.
Water bucket: no item id for the bucket was found. The guide gives 2695102974 for 'Fill the water bucket', but that id was not verified in the client locale.
Return-to-Pappy: 5100270 and 5100358 are both 'Return to Pappy Farnum'. Which one belongs to this quest is not settled. The guide places the step after the fires.
Reward 4 coins comes only from the guide and video /00526. No client reward string was found.
The intro speaker for 4420041 is untagged in the client. Attributing it to Pappy is inferred from the giver field and the description.
No wiki or article entry exists for this title, so there is no external corroboration.

open: Record objectives (gather 1003 x5, craft recipe 2002 x1, talk 9000000050) have no client text support. The craft step has no evidence at all. The text-side objectives above are wording matches only.
No client text is tagged to Gear Up! for the copper-ore, smelt or turn-in steps; 76108, 5100121 and 5100119 are untagged candidates.

Next link is unresolved. Our record says Your First Weapon, but the wiki's prerequisite for Your First Weapon is 'Learn to Mine & Smelt Ore', and the client's nearest title is 'Mine and Smelt' (4420061). Whether Gear Up! precedes Mine and Smelt, or Mine and Smelt sits between them, is not settled by evidence. Native run accepted Your First Weapon after Gear Up!, which is our server only.
Previous link Farming 101 rests only on the Adventurer guide row order (Adventurer.md:71-73); Farming 101's record does not link Gear Up! as next.
Rewards: the record's 5 coins is a reconstructed fallback and is dropped. The native run's 10 coins and 25 Miner XP are our server, not retail, so they are not listed.
dialog.complete: 4420060 is tagged to Mine and Smelt, so it is not used for Gear Up!. No tagged completion line exists.

open: Two title families share the name 'Cobblestone Showdown': the 4420 family (4420105-4420108, with 4420110 'Defeat Mac and free Cobblestone Village.' under the separate 'Show Who's Boss' title 4420109) and the 5100 family (5100367/5100370/5100080, 5100372 'Defeat Mac', 5100073 reward). Which family the live quest used is not settled by client text alone. The objective list mixes both and should be checked against the record's structure.

4420110 is the text the adventure guide cites as the A13 objective, and 4085590485 is its hash form. It is not the same as 4420110's locale-id form in the record. The 4420109 block split is unresolved.
Dialog.complete 4420108 is inferred from block order, not from a tag. 5100072 is an unconfirmed alternate complete candidate.

The record's 5 coins is a reconstructed fallback and conflicts with the observed 25 coins/25 Brawler XP in notes/Tasks.md:105. The notes capture is our own run, not a shipped server payout. Keep the record's 5-coin value as unverified until a builder decides.
Mac has no verified NPC id. The Mac name hashes (652126593, 1051447913, 3613719656) are not locale ids.
Bartle's giver locale_id is not evidenced in the pack (the name hash is 1532649583).
Enabling the record is a builder decision. The predecessor chain (3000011, 3000012) is listed as blocked in Starting Quest Chains.md, which the later capture appears to supersede.

open: Objectives: the record wires one talk objective (npc 9500000519, text locale 4420118). The go step 'Enter the Royal Palace' (4420119) is client-sourced but has no record objective or geometry. The third step in Adventurer.md:79, 'Talk to Queen Valerian inside the Royal Palace', has no verified locale id: the guide's 1222469162 is a ucdt hash, and the earlier locale 293177 link was not verified, so it is dropped.

Rewards: 5 coins is the reconstructed fallback and is the only wired value. The playtest figures (25 coins + 25 XP on completion) are one build's notes, the XP job is not stated, and they are not wired. The 25 Brawler XP belongs to the palace-visit discovery event, not this completion.
Title variant 'Off to the Queen: Royal Palace' is confirmed in Adventurer.md:79 (ucdt 1346235735), but I could not confirm a locale id for it in this pass, so no locale id is claimed.

Papers (locale:140671) also belongs to this area: 140672 'Confront the Chugawug by Jacque's cafe', 140677 'Return to Nomi in Sanctuary', and 140675 handing over the pass. This may be a separate follow-on quest or a branch of Take a Number. Unresolved; I did not merge it into this record's objectives.

open: Entry quests 'Being a Better Archer' (locale 442268 / ucdt 3975471143, objective 1598517969) and 'Aiming For Archery' (117607, ucdt 525918602) are not set as previous. Archer.md:29 calls them optional entry quests that point to Lugabow, and greenwood_forest.json:16706 agrees, but their record giver ids (9000000514 / 9000000515) disagree and no client text links them to 3010003. Needs a giver reconciliation before they are asserted as prerequisites.

Next line is data-only. archer.json gives Test of Agility (3010004) and Oath of Honor (3010006) prerequisite 3010003, and gives Taking Aim (3010005) prerequisite 3010004. Oath of Honor's place after Taking Aim is therefore unsettled. Only the direct link to Test of Agility is listed. The wiki order puts Taking Aim second, so the true sequence is unresolved.

The per-step npc ids 9500000289 / 9500000309 / 9500000290 are reconstructed T194 bindings, not client facts. The client does not say which recruit each step names, so the builder should treat each step as any-of-three recruit actors. Recruit names 22168-22170 were not re-verified in this pass.

Rewards are unverified. The 5 coins and 15 Archer job XP are a T194 fallback, not a client fact, so the rewards array is left empty. The job grant text (2967121729) is in the client, but no reward value is stated.
dialog.complete is unconfirmed. 9701 (wiki-cited debrief) and 22073 are candidates only.
The job-35 gate (Archer must be learned and activated before the chapter is offered) comes from notes/Autopilot/T194.md, not client text. Check before go-live.
Thugawugs (locale 20574 / 20577) has only a wiki-based link to Lugabow and no offer text. It is not part of this chain.

open: Locale 77819 is hint-tagged to this quest, zone Sanctuary: 'Nice job taking care of those robgoblins. Now I want you to travel east of Sanctuary to Lookout Pointe and meet with Bowman Bilter. Good luck!' It reads as the hand-off from a Sanctuary robgoblin quest, not from Paralyzing Poison. The true predecessor is unresolved. The Paralyzing Poison link is repo-only and should be treated as unconfirmed.

Bowman Bilter's spawn zone is unresolved: 77810 and 77815 say Lookout Pointe, while 77837 says just outside Passwind Pass, north of Blackspore. The talk objective should not be wired to a zone until a spawn check is done.
Locale 115628, 115635 and 78428 were cited by the earlier answer but could not be found in the client. They are dropped and not used as evidence.
No progress dialog line was found, so dialog.progress is null.
The kill count is not stated in client text, so count is null. Target 76573 is the singular NPC name, not a confirmed spawn record.
No reward data was found in the client or wiki. The wiki alias 'A Stunning Effect' is unverified.
The repo's numeric quest id 3010020 is a reconstructed batch key, not a value the client confirms.

q3020020.title: Blacksmith: Silver Appearance

line.name: Blacksmith job line, Band 4: Billie JoBob and Silverray (Blackspore, level 15 to 20)

objectives.text: Speak with Billie
Find Billie JoBob outside the passage to Blackspore and give him the Glistening Scythes you forged
Billie has recommended that you head through the path to Blackspore just behind him. Once through the cave, find Quagmire Quarry to the South and speak with Silverray.

rewards.value: Billie's racecar purchase is mentioned in the thanks text; no reward item or coin amount is confirmed.

open: Conflict on the item: client lines 95170-95172 (this quest's own id block) ask for the Glistening Scythes, but the wiki-derived Blacksmith.md row 20 and the 94576/94600/94605/94606/387885 texts ask for a Rowdy Rumbler Hammer for Billie's locked chest. The hammer lines may belong to a different Billie quest or an earlier version. Client wins, so the objective is recorded as the Glistening Scythes, but this is not settled.
Offer dialog id not confirmed. 387561 ('Billie has been waiting a while for this favor I need to ask of you.') is a candidate but its quest link is unknown, so offer is null.
Progress dialog 95172 is Billie's line on receiving the scythes; it is marked as progress, but the client does not say which dialog is the first hand-in.

The Glistening Scythes craft step has no client objective line of its own; only the delivery is in the text. The scythes were said to come from Mili Ironcall (95172), so Mili may be an upstream giver, not confirmed.
Rewards not confirmed: no coin or item amount found in the client text for this quest.
The giver's npc_id 9000000025 maps to Billie JoBob via npcs_unresolved.json:282, not a confirmed server spawn. The name locale id 94635 is a text line and may not be the actor name string.
Our record has no numeric server quest id from the guide; 3020020 is a batch key, not a confirmed live id.
Next quest 'Blacksmith: Wand Replacement' comes from the wiki order and the client's Silverray hand-off (784862031 in the guide), not a direct link in the client text.

q3020024.title: Blacksmith: Reach Level 20

line.name: Blacksmith quest line (Silverray, Quagmire Quarry, Blackspore Swamp, levels 15 to 20)

objectives.text: Reach Level 20 as a Blacksmith, then return to Silverray.

open: Previous link 'Blacksmith: Scythes of Stalking' is order-only (wiki Silverray list order). No prerequisite_quest_ids entry links it to 3020024 in our data, and 3020023's record is not verified as a data predecessor.
dialog.offer 387562 is disputed: its client hint is Blacksmith: Reach Level 20, but the guide attributes the same wording to Scythes of Stalking's closing line. Confirm the owner in the build.
dialog.complete left null. Our record's end_text_string_id 387565 is also cited by the guide as Forging Rumors' intro (Blacksmith.md:125), so it is not confirmed as this quest's completion line.

Objective text: 387564 is confirmed as the client's wording for this quest, but 387641 and 387645 are alternate Level 20 objective strings under a different hint (Blacksmith: Level 20); the build should choose one.
Silverray's NPC name locale id was not confirmed (77706 'Silverray' exists but its type was not verified), so giver.locale_id is null.
No reward is known; the record has none and no reward text was found.
Objective kind 'other' is used because the quest is a job-level gate; the ContentDb has no level-gate kind.

No client quest id or dialog group links either set to record 3020025, so the objectives cannot be assigned to this record.

Objectives withheld. Candidate client texts exist (100161 'Seek out Anata Caliburn, north of Blackspore at the Awespring Tributary.', 100165 'Find Anata Caliburn', 100166 'Locate Anata Caliburn. Rumor has it she was seen somewhere north of Blackspore, near the Awespring Tributary.'), but their order, kind and target are not in any client source. Target locale for Anata Caliburn is 100175 'Anata Caliburn' if needed.

Dialog ids withheld. Offer candidate 95143 and end candidate 95129 match the Anata story by wording only (guide hashes 2877234734 and 106092907), and 95129 may belong to Legendary Summersaber. No progress id was found.
Rewards unknown: no client or wiki source gives a reward.
Giver Silverray (9000000203) rests on guide row 25 and the NPC notes; no client text ties 95097 or 100160 to this npc. Silverray's locale id was not found.

Next link 'Blacksmith: Lady of the Lake' (95098) comes from record order and guide row 26, where its giver is Anata Caliburn; the record's own giver is 9000000006, and the client objective texts for Lady of the Lake (95108, 95109) are tagged to Legendary Summersaber. The Silverray-to-Anata handoff therefore depends on resolving row 25's identity.
Guide title hashes (ucdt 962163740 / ugdt 3234647877 / bare 257137144) map to no locale id in the pack.

open: Identity: 439730 'Blacksmith: Grave Discovery' has no objective or dialog tagged to it. The Drake Boneyard objective set (440002-440008) is tagged to the 'Blacksmithing: Grave Discovery' form (440001). Which form our record 3020042 maps to is unresolved, and I have not linked the objectives to this record.

Dialog: 439729, 439731 and 439732 are tagged to From Scraps to Iron and Good Ol' Sunstones, not to this quest. Their text (Drake Boneyard, Feathered Graveyard) suggests a place in the Jarvus search, but client tags do not confirm it. Dialog ids left null. The critique that 439731 is this quest's description is noted: the text fits, but the client tag contradicts it.

Order: previous and next are left empty. The repo row 42 sits after Clash of the Apprentice in table order, but it is marked placement unknown. The text chain (From Scraps to Iron -> Feathered Graveyard search -> Good Ol' Sunstones) is only textual inference, and the client tags point the other way. No source confirms either order, so I have not asserted one.
Giver: npc 9000000516 has no name, zone or role in the repo or the client. Red Stonehammer is the line trainer, so she is a probable giver by line membership only. Not assigned.
Offer, progress and complete dialog ids, objectives and rewards are not found for this title. The record is not wireable as it stands; it stays disabled.

open: Previous is guide-based ordering, not a stored prerequisite: record 3030021 has prerequisite_quest_ids empty. Per the guide, M1 Prey on the Cray is entered from C6, H5 or S5; the guide's entry edge means S5 Brawler: Cemetery Security (3030019) and the unnamed C6/H5 quests lead into the Petra band, but the guide does not state that they directly precede M2. C6 and H5 titles are not identified in the pack, so they are unresolved.

Next is parallel-ish: Contract: Hello Fernando (M3) is only 'after M2' and is repeatable; Splendid Silver! (M4) is 'after M2'. M4 then leads to Brawler: Finding a Buyer (M5, 3030024), which is not in this quest's next list as a direct successor.

Giver conflict: the NPC dossier says Petra hands out the Contract: Hello Fernando referral, while record 3030022 names Fernando Flexsteel (9500000785) as giver and the guide M3 row also lists Fernando. This does not affect M2, whose offer text (387358) is spoken by Petra.
The guide's ids 344566168 and 3317336969 do not resolve as client ids; the client ids 387363 and 387360 are used instead.
The record has no min_level; the level 5 gate comes only from text 387363 and 387358.
No wiki page for Petra or this quest was in the pack; the wiki is not used as evidence.

open: The Sorin-refusal opening (repo M13 texts 3669888178, 1218945572, 2645956707) was not located in the client by id in this pass. Client strings 72634 ('Sorin has recently been scammed...') and 72647/72649 ('Talk to Jeni Shortfuse in Snowhill') exist in the 72xxx block, but that block is tagged to the not_live quest 'Wrongfully Accused' (72666). So the opening is not wired as a live objective here.

Next link is unproven. Repo M14 and the record batch order put 'Brawler: Fraudulent Brawler' (3030033) next, and the wiki's 'Fradulent Buyer' shares the Jeni-in-Snowhill theme. The client hint for the shared Jeni sentences is An Honest Mistake, so the overlap is unresolved. Do not reuse objective ids for 3030033 until settled.

Speaker of 141079 and 141082 is not stated in the client. 141082 is used as the end text by inference. Progress dialog 141083 ('Ice Trolls are no match...') is hinted to this quest, but its speaker is unknown, so progress is left null.
Defeat step has no kill count. 141101 is a stronger alternative text for the same step and is not wired as a separate objective.

Ice Troll target locale id 4212 (cited in the previous answer) was not re-verified, so target_locale_id is null. Mayor Crystalline's locale id is not confirmed. Repo ucdt hashes were not converted to locale ids.
No reward is evidenced for this quest in the pack or the client.

open: Step order is not confirmed by any source. The objectives are listed as an unordered set. The progress dialog 104203 ('The big chugawug next to Shifty needs to have a word with you.') is attached as progress by inference only, and it does not name an objective.

The Brewmaster NPC is not identified. 104206 is objective text only. Wugawump (41237, 'Sasparilla Brewmaster Wugawump') is the likely brewmaster, since the wiki files Squash the Shuffler under him, but no source ties 104206 to him, so the target is null.
The turn-in NPC for the completion dialog 104211 is not identified.
No reward source was found; rewards is empty.

The NPC record wugachug.json quests_given_text also lists Shifty Dealings and Squash the Shuffler as Shifty's. The wiki and the built records put those under Garrison Gold and Wugawump, so the NPC text is likely wrong. This does not change this quest's giver.
Previous and next links come from the wiki's ordering and the guide's table, not from server prerequisites. The repo record has no prerequisite_quest_ids.

open: Previous is unresolved. Candidates: Card Duelist: Esther's Special Card (407028 is Esther's hand-off line, which points to the Esther encounter; but the repo guide's row 32 ends with Esther, and the Esther chain's next per another answer is Card Duelist: Confronting Ambrose, a conflict). Next is unresolved. Candidates: Card Duelist: Break Time (guide row 30, inferred; its lines 407016/407017 are Dominic's own break-from-Esther lines) and Card Duelist: Gifted Cards (413779, unbuilt; its line 413784 mentions Dominic's new cards from Ambrose, but the link is not confirmed by a hand-off line). open: Giver is not settled. No client line shows Esther offering this quest; the offer lines 407010 and 407011 are Dominic's. The giver is either Dominic or unknown; the guide's Esther is only an inference. Name ids 407093 (Esther) and 407094 (Dominic) did not resolve in my locale check, so giver locale_id and npc name stay null here. npc_id left null rather than guessed.

Next is changed to Esther, the Brains based on the 407017 to 407020 text sequence, which contradicts guide row order (Special Card before Brains). Esther's Special Card's own previous must be made to agree with whichever is chosen; the other answer lists Esther, the Brains as its previous, so this is consistent with that answer.

Objective 407038/407039/407041 belong to the hint group 'Quick Game of Cards' (407037), which may be a separate quest title from 407012. Whether they are the same quest's objectives is inferred, not proven.

Locale id checks for 407093, 407094, 407117 and 407121 returned no matches in my pass, so the reward and the Dominic and Esther name ids remain unverified. The Power Nap reward is from a battle description, not a confirmed grant.

Objective guide ids (2329284098, 3359647970) are hashed guide keys, not locale ids; only locale ids are used. ContentDb has no free-text objective field, so these are recorded for the build team, not wired.

line.name: Card Duelist, Access Granted to Final Dig chain (text-ordered, not record-confirmed)

open: Giver is unresolved. The record says Tyrone Shadowshard (9000000224). The only Final Dig-tagged objective, 413808, says Edwin Goldstory in Briarwood. The generic lines 413827 (Tyrone, Blackspore) and 413828 (Edwin, Briarwood) are parallel variants with no quest tag, so they do not decide it. Do not wire the giver until a offer/accept dialog or NPC script ties 413807 to one NPC. The Edwin npc id 9500000125 from the earlier answer is a reconstructed key and is not confirmed, so it is left out.
No offer dialog is tagged to 413807. 413806 is tagged to Access Granted.
Sir Wellington's dig site has no NPC id; the target is text-only (place name 20530). Kind 'go' is an inference from the objective wording.

Previous and next are text-ordered only. Access Granted and Cardie Partay have no record ids, and no answer confirms either link. The Cardie Partay link is one-sided in our records (its record lists no previous).

Four Round Challenge (413799/413800) is a plausible prerequisite but is not in any repo prerequisite field. 413802 'Keep what you find' belongs to that challenge, not to Final Dig, so it is not counted as a reward here.
The line name 'Shattered Past' comes from the build guide row, not from client text, so it is not used as a claim. The earlier claim of a Tyrone/Blackspore zone is not supported by 413808.
Earlier sources 417205 and the wiki/article citations were dropped because they do not describe this quest. The wiki has no Final Dig page.

Return to Madam Zelda in Blackspore and tell her what you found out from Clancy Blackheart.

Locale 7964 ('face another one of the Barons lackeys') is unassigned and may belong to Slow and Steady.
Giver locale_id, Madam Zelda's name locale id, and Bud Grimyfoot's NPC id were not found in the pack, so they stay null. Quest-level coins/xp were not found.
Live status rests on one news article plus the wiki list. A playthrough or second source would raise confidence.

open: Deck fights: the four deck objectives (5100211/5100213/5100215/5100217) sit under the block titled 'TCG5 - Quest 2' (5100205), which also holds the Milo talk strings 5100206/5100207. Not confirmed as objectives of 5100179; the guide lists them for row 59, so they are likely Milo's but the id link is unverified.

Completion: 5100294 ('He can go free') is the probable free-Magetech step, but its zone tag (Shady Shores in the earlier pack) conflicts with Sunstone Valley. I did not confirm its owner, so it is not used as dialog.complete. 5100181 is the only confirmed end text.

Line order: the guide gives Realmkeepers as prerequisite (row 57). Junkmaker Jort (row 58) is also listed as 'After The Realmkeepers Are Missing!', so Jort's order relative to Milo is unresolved; the client sends the player to Jort first (5100183/5100185), which may make Jort the true previous. Next is left empty: the guide's rows 60 (Quizzical Yucca) and 61 (Ironteeth) are guide-only, and Ironteeth's client text makes him the last captive, so neither is confirmed as Milo's successor. Return from the Rumbledome (guide row 62) is also unconfirmed as a successor.
Prerequisite_quest_ids in the record is empty; the guide suggests Realmkeepers (locale 5100175) but this was not changed.
Rewards: the Milo E. Lizardo Hero card (5P4) is in the guide, wiki and locale:442179 (the battle line for the Tournament deck), but it is not tied to this quest's id. No coin or XP reward was found.

The offer says 'defeat him', so the defeat steps are listed here from the offer and the guide, but the builder must confirm whether they belong to this record or to a separate Shady Shores Ironteeth record. The guide order is the line evidence; the data gap is unresolved. Record 3070001 'Become a Fisherman' is the guide E1 but its giver is the Sanctuary Message Board, and no record link to 3070003 was found, so it is not listed as previous.
The 'talk' objective kind is authored policy from T244 (notes/Autopilot/T244.md:26-27), not client-sourced. No Reed dialog binds to locale:417056, which is a descriptive line.

The guide's hash 676088078 for the E3 tutorial line does not resolve to locale 417056 in any source checked; it is not used as evidence. The title and objective ids come from the record and the MiniGameData row.
Dialog offer, progress and complete ids were not found. 417054 is reel-meter UI text.
Reed's 'extra gear' reward item (2663118808, Fisherman.md:56) is unidentified, so no item reward is listed. The coin and XP values are reconstructed playtest values with no client or guide source.

The critique that the record's title id 417055 should be the 3359670549 hash is noted: the guide and NPC notes give 3359670549 / 1197071914 as ucdt/ugdt values, and the record uses 417055 after a hash correction (stillwater_crossing.json:10188).

q3070011.title: Fisherman: Bigger is Better

line.name: Unresolved. Client text places this in the Ernest McScuttle / Karl Kippersun creeping-cod contest at Darklit Lagoon. The repo places record 3070011 in Jonah Relicreel's bait chain at Sacred Grove Shallows, and the guide itself says the title-to-row match is not proven.

objectives.text: Catch a bigger creeping cod than Ernest in Darklit Lagoon.
Catch a large creeping cod
Show the fish to Karl

rewards.value: Unnamed consolation item (the rival says 'I won't let you go away empty handed'); no item id or coin amount found

open: Giver unresolved. No client line for 419155-419164 names Jonah Relicreel. Jonah (9000000117) comes only from the repo record, guide and NPC file, and his row 7 objective (butter flyfish, Sacred Grove Shallows, locale 25343/1138155636) does not match the client text. The client's named parties are Ernest McScuttle (409211, rival) and Karl Kippersun (409224, judge); neither is confirmed as the giver NPC id. Left null rather than guessed.

Line conflict: the repo's chain (previous 3070009 'Itty Bitty Bait', next 3070012 'Better Bacon Bait' and 3070013 'Bacon Bait') is repo-stated and unverified. No client line ties those titles to 419156, so previous and next are left empty instead of asserting an unproven chain. If the repo link is kept, it must be marked repo-only.

Dialog ids 419155/419157/419158 are linked to title 419156 by locale adjacency, not by any text that names this quest. The client text is consistent with the quest but does not prove the link. 419157 is the description and has no schema slot.

dialog.progress is null: no confirmed progress line. 419165 is a rival taunt, and 419162 ('Reel in the biggest creeping cod you can, or else Ernest gets to keep the fishing spot') is an unused sourced objective line.
Reward: no item id or coin amount was found for the consolation prize.
Prior-quest candidate: 'Fisherman: Find Your Own Spot!' (409213/409214) shares the creeping-cod wager text and may be a predecessor by content. It is inference only and is not recorded as previous.
Objective 2 uses Large Creeping Cod (407681) because the text says 'large'. Generic Creeping Cod (99930) is the alternative.

Critique on the earlier answer: its objectives and title were correct, but its line claimed a Jonah chain it had not established. This answer keeps the client-supported objectives and leaves the chain open, rather than contradicting the repo's prerequisite data.

open: Giver is unresolved. The record and dossier bind Dooba (9000000308), but no client line in 412249-412259 names a speaker. Helena appears only inside the text. locale 37569 is flagged as a fragment, so locale_id is null. Helena (116519) is not adopted as giver: the guide's row 39 ties this text to a different quest.

Story conflict: the client tags the Stickleback text to 412250 (Live Bait!), but the guide's row 39 gives it to 'Fisherman: To the Rescue!' (412262). The client wins on tagging, so the title stays, but the guide's row 23 describes a Nettletrout minigame story. The two stories cannot both be this record. Objectives are kept as client-tagged and unverified.
Title id cell in the guide (3169546093 / 4245194083) does not match locale 412250; the source of that mismatch is unresolved.

Previous (3070026) and next (3070028) are record bindings and guide guesses marked as unconfirmed (rows 22 to 24). No client ordering confirms them. Dooba's Secret's giver is Karl Kippersun (9000000127) per the guide, not Dooba.

Zone is null. The Stickleback lines carry no zone tag in the pack; the earlier Wintery Basin claim rested on 412220 and 410081, which are not tagged to this quest. The guide's row 23 gives Nettleseed.
Progress line: 412256 is used here, but 412259 is also tagged to this title, so which progress line is live is unverified.
No rewards found in the pack, and no wiki or article evidence of shipping.

Record identity is unresolved. The supplies body may be a step of 3070038 ('Fisherman: Joining Big J's Crew', title 410500) rather than its own record 3070036. The repo record 3070036 keeps the 9000000219 giver, which is unresolved (npcs_unresolved.json) and not Big J.
Giver Big J (9000000024) is inferred from the offer text 410438 (Big J speaking) and from record 3070038, not from record 3070036 itself.
'Find the supplies' (410450) has no target or count in any source. No reward text was found in locales 410438 to 410453, so rewards are empty.
The previous link to 'Setting Ernest Straight' follows the repo prerequisite and guide row 31; the guide places the Sacred Grove tournament (row 32) between them, so the direct link is not confirmed.

Giver is unconfirmed by dialog. Murphy comes from the record's giver_npc_id 9000000158 and the guide's dagger-marked guess. The offer lines 410200/410202/410203 have no speaker tag, so the speaker is not proven to be Murphy.

Zone conflict: repo snowhill.json lists Lenore (9000000131) in Snowhill, but client locale:410212 tags her Frostbitten Banks. The client tag is preferred for the hand-off, and snowhill.json needs fixing.

No quest_objective string is tied to record 3070047. The guide cites 2418676270 ('Hopefully Lenore at Frostbitten Banks...') for this quest, but the client text with that wording is locale:410205, which is tagged to Showing Off Your Skills. Objectives therefore stay empty; a builder needs a source for a step such as 'Talk to Lenore at Frostbitten Banks'.
No reward text or reward record was found.

Successors 3070048 (Feed the Penguins), 3070049 (Showing Off Your Skills), 3070050 (The Big One) are listed by record prerequisite 3070047 (fisherman.json:2323, 2371, 2419, per prior pack, not re-read). Their relative order is not established. Only 3070049 is tied to client text (410205, 410208, 410215). The guide's successor givers (Lenore, Melvin) are guesses.
Wiki and article lookups returned no source for this quest, so there is no shipped-game confirmation.

line.name: Fisherman quests of Lenore's family, Frostbitten Banks (Snowhill), guide Cluster H
previous: Fisherman: My Hut is Your Hut

objectives.text: Talk to Chip Numbwing
Talk to Lenore
Talk to Melvin
Show Melvin a thing or two about fishing at the Frostbitten Banks.
Get some perfect casts
Catch an extra large Goofy Grouper
Catch a platypus
Return to Lenore

open: Giver: Melvin is the name in the client and the offer voice, but the guide marks the giver with a dagger and 410219/410221 are Lenore lines. Lenore (410212) may be the real giver; unresolved.

Next quest is unknown. Siblings (Feed the Penguins row 44, The Big One row 46) share the After 43 prerequisite, but no source shows a successor, so next is empty as unknown rather than as a confirmed endpoint.

Platypus and Goofy Grouper objectives: the client hint tags them to this quest, but the guide notes 410239 'What Is It?!' is ambiguous between this quest and the Shallows shark quest, and the Big One (row 46) also uses a fish-size theme. Included as tagged; ownership not independently confirmed. Platypus has no locale id for the target name.
Rewards: none in the pack or repo; left empty.
Record 3070050 links to 3070047, not 3070049; the record prerequisite does not show a chain link between siblings.

q3070050.title: Fisherman: The "Big" One

line.name: Fisherman job quest line (repo jobs.json sequence; Anna's Sacred Grove beginner group per Fisherman.md Cluster A)
previous: Fisherman: My Hut is Your Hut

objectives.text: Help Anna Mudskipper by reeling in a large butter flyfish.
Take the butter flyfish to Anna Mudskipper.
Take the enormous butter flyfish to Reed Stillwater at the fishing job center.

open: Giver spawn is unresolved. The record's giver_npc_id 9000000401 is an unresolved Melvin entry, and the client text shows Anna Mudskipper as the speaker and the delivery target, not a confirmed spawn. A builder must choose Anna's spawn; no id is asserted here.

Previous link: 3070047 is the record's only prerequisite and sits first in the jobs.json sequence, but the client text for 409057-409073 never names a predecessor. The zone of 3070047 (Frostbitten/Snowhill per guide row 43) differs from this quest's Sacred Grove tag, so the link is recorded from the repo, not confirmed by client text.

Ordering neighbour: jobs.json places 3070049 'Fisherman: Showing Off Your Skills' directly before 3070050. That is ordering-only evidence, not a confirmed prerequisite, and its giver is Melvin per the guide, so it is not listed as previous here.

Next: no successor is confirmed. jobs.json ends the visible sequence at 3070050 in the shown lines, and the client gives no following quest title. 409094 and 409096 point to Reed after a shark catch, which belongs to 'Fisherman: Beware of Sharks!' (409076), not this quest.

Guide row 46 (Melvin, Frostbitten Banks, title ids 2246774640 / 3510437043) describes the same title with different ids that do not resolve in the client; treated as a stale or separate entry. Fisherman.md:34 cites 4003707613 for the butter-flyfish wording, which was not verified as a client string for this quest.
Target locale for the butter flyfish is unverified (an earlier pass gave 99925, which was not checked here), so target_locale_id is null.
Order of the Anna delivery (409066) and the Reed delivery (409068) is not stated; the listed order is only the string order.
Reel-in count is not stated in the client; count is null.
Reed's location (Stillwater Crossing) comes from Fisherman.md and 408272 greeting context, not from a line in 409068/409071 that names the town.
No reward text exists in the pack or client for this quest; rewards are empty.

line.name: Kart Driver Thunder Falls rival arc (Tier 3, per guide; unconfirmed)

objectives.text: Linx has arrived at Thunder Falls! It looks like he's followed you again. Ace is concerned that he might be up to no good and wants you to go check on him.
Apparently Chase Wheeler has taken some of Linx Redlines parts. Help out Linx by recovering the first stolen part.

rewards.value: Slick tires (kept by the player; no item id evidenced)

open: Giver is not settled. The guide and the unresolved NPC table link 9000000382 to the name Linx Redline, but the offer line 394691 has an unnamed speaker and the arrival text is about Linx. No client NPC record ties this id to the offer dialog. The giver name is kept only as the guide's claim.

Zone conflict: the offer and arrival lines are Thunder Falls, but the recovery text (395364, 395366, 395372) is Tangletrack Speedway-tagged. The guide's row 23 places all of it at Thunder Falls. Which zone the recovery steps belong to is unresolved.

The four recovery steps (first to fourth stolen part) are text matches only. Their counts and the target are inferred from the Stolen Part string 395172. Only the first step is listed here, and the second to fourth steps are not confirmed as separate objectives.

Previous link 'Age Before Beauty' rests on the guide's row 22 order. The title exists (3527) but no quest record or reveal line links it. The flagged 101226 is for the same name, so the prerequisite is unverified.

Next link 'Settling the Score' (title 3528) and the reveal line 394697 are not reconciled. The guide cites 174930286 for the reveal, and 394697 carries the same text with a Making Amends hint tag. The two ids were not reconciled.
Guide ids 1224297660, 3503606713, 2158186669, 212127093 are not locale ids and were not used. No coin or XP amount is evidenced. The slick tires have no item id.

line.name: Kart Driver job line, tier 3 - Thunder Falls Speedway

objectives.text: Beat Linx Redline in the "Settling the Score" race at Thunder Falls Speedway.

rewards.value: No coin or item reward found. Story outcome only: Linx keeps Chase Wheeler's parts after the race (395216), though reveal 394697 says he returns them if the player wins. The two conflict.

open: Objective 395230 (find Linx's kart, grab my parts) and 395233 (get Chase's parts back) are dropped. Our guide assigns them to Making Amends (row 25), and the critic is right that 395233 is not the guide's cited id for that row (the guide uses 3635590744). Its hint tag is still unresolved.
Objective 395228 'Talk to Chase Wheeler' is dropped: no source places it in this quest.
395219 'Beat Linx Redline in a race at Thunder Falls Speedway.' is a generic race line; it may be a second objective or a repeat of 395225. Not used.
Parts outcome conflicts: 394697 says beating Linx returns the parts, 395216 says Linx keeps them. The reward and story outcome are not settled.
Dialog slots 395214 (progress) and 395216 (complete) are inferred from content; no dialog-state table confirms them, and the offer dialog is not identified.
Guide cites 174930286 for the reveal, but that id did not resolve in the locale tool. The verified reveal text is 394697; the guide's id is unverified.

Previous/next titles 'Kart Driver: A Helping Hand' (394692) and 'Kart Driver: Making Amends' (394702) are from the guide and were not re-verified as quest_title tags. Giver npc 9000000381 is not checked against NPC data.
The critique that A Helping Hand's next list omits this quest is valid. That record must be fixed to list 'Kart Driver: Settling the Score' as next.

dialog.complete 395265 is a best match, not confirmed: the line names no speaker, and 394739 (Sprint Challenge, a different sponsor) uses similar 'system' phrasing. Treat it as probable.

Rewards: no reward or payout text found in the client for this quest.

line.name: Medic job quest line (Band 1, Doctor Gordon / Greyli Dustywings chain)

objectives.text: Collect the fruits and vegetables Doctor Gordon has requested.
objectives.target: Sunflower farm ground (reconstructed visit_position stand-in, [-1444.961,-37.04161,70.83138], radius 8; not a client target)

objectives.text: Return the fruits and vegetables to Nurse Naia and talk to her.

open: Locale 23014 is hinted to 'Sanctuary I Hate Shots!', not Palatable Pills. The critics are right that it is not confirmed as this quest's step. The text fits the hand-off, but I have not found a line tagged to this quest for the Naia step. Treat objectives[1] as unverified. Locale 23001, which the prior answer cited, is flagged not_live and is not used here.

The first step is not a client objective. Locale 76397 is a text string with no target. The server visit_position is a reconstructed stand-in because harvesting is Chef-only (T278), and the 'ten of each' item list has no proven item definitions. No item is granted.

Rewards are empty. The record's 5 coins and 20 Medic job XP (job 11) are a reconstructed fallback (T278 says the retail payout is unknown), so the builder should remove them rather than treat them as data.
Enable state is unresolved: medic.json:359 and T197 say disabled, T278 and the record say enabled. Settle this before wiring and before marking live.

Doctor Gordon's name locale id 823955810 appears only in repo notes (NPCs - Sanctuary.md:42), not in client text for the offer speaker, so locale_id is left null. The client does not name the offer speaker.
Target locale 7611 for Nurse Naia comes from the prior pack and was not re-checked in this pass.

Line order: the guide places Take Your Vitamins (3090005) after this quest, but the server prerequisite is House Call alone (medic.json:422). Achieve Level 5 needs both 3090004 and 3090005, so it is a merge point, not a clean sequel. Take Your Vitamins is a parallel branch, not listed in next.

open: The offer text (387462) sends the player to help Beth Callahan in Queensfield before returning. No separate Beth objective text for this quest was found, so the record keeps one talk step. Whether a tracked Beth step exists is unsettled.
Speaker tag on 387462 says Beth Callahan, but the text reads as Gordon's voice. Giver is kept as Gordon per the wiki and record.
Rewards (5 coins, 25 Medic job XP in the record) are reconstructed (R) with no client, wiki or article source, so left empty.
The report-back step (387477) is a level gate with no level-up event in our data; the step is a reconstruction of how the game tracks it.
The progress dialog id was not found, so it is null.
Next-quest 3090007 is a repeatable Bixie contract per the repo test comment, so it is not used as the next step. The real title of the successor is not confirmed beyond Surgical Precision.

open: Giver is unconfirmed. Flu Medicine has no item locale id, so target_locale_id is null. The timer length and any rewards are not stated in any source. 75983 is a completion-flavour line, not a reward.
Why the record is enabled=false is unexplained. This is the main reason live is 'unsure' rather than 'yes'.

open: Giver is unknown. Row 0a names no giver; it says any ore node or forge prompt. Therin (9000000217, locale 185) is only the talk target of the objective, not a verified giver. The record's giver_npc_id 9000000001 has no verified NPC.

Line order is unsettled. Row 0a is marked optional and sits beside row 1 'So, You Want To Be A Miner?', which the guide lists as the start of the line. Our batch order (3100001, 3100002, 3100003 in jobs.json:1020-1022) is not confirmed as retail order, so previous and next are left empty. Successor 3100002 is not claimed.

dialog.complete is null. The pack's end_text 139750 ('Looks like you came at the right time. I might have a job for you.') reads like an offer or greeting and is not tied to this record's completion. dialog.offer is unknown.
Rewards are unknown. Row 0a says unknown, and the coin and XP values in miner.json belong to other records.

Disable reason: the W110 note cites 9000000217 as unspawned, but the pack's npc_spawns_extra.json row shows it resolves. I did not re-check the spawn row myself. Whether the record should stay disabled is left to the builder.

The critique's point about client 2518410683 is accepted: that string is the copper-vein prompt, not the Therin prompt. The Therin prompt is 2686999940, per Miner.md row 0a. It is not used as evidence here. locale:139754 is also not used, since it is a different objective string.

Record kind is gather_resource with resource_id 2739 (Copper Ore item definition). The client confirms the name 'Copper Ore' (21917) but not the item id link 2739; that link is a repo reconstruction. Objective kind 'collect' is used here, per the output vocabulary.
The wiki 'Miner' page lists this quest first, but the wiki is only corroboration. Quest order rests on the record's next link to 3100003 and the giver's quest list.
Record 3100002's prerequisite list is empty, so this is treated as the start of the line.

open: No objective or reward data is in the pack beyond the travel/speak step; the client shows no item, coin or XP reward for this quest, so rewards is empty rather than guessed.

The client has two titles: 77416 ('Miner: Finding Southvale', the quest title, hint Southvale) and 77421 ('Finding Southvale', used as the journal/hint name). I treated them as the same quest; the record title uses 77416.
The offer NPC is taken from the record and dossier (Derp, 9000000069); no dialog string names a speaker ID, so the offer dialog's speaker is inferred.
Is 'Miner: Finding Southvale' itself the quest the record means by 3100013? The record matches by title and sequence, not a server quest id, so this is inferred from the guide.
No wiki page or article confirms this quest's existence or live status.
The 'Gems For Good Luck' client strings 77440-77446 (objectives 'Mine tourmaline', 'Show the gems to Mili') belong to the next quest, not this one.
The client cluster shows 77420 (music minigame text) and 77403/77405 tutorial lines, which do not belong to this quest and were excluded.

open: Giver is unverified. Pinkelug comes from our record and the Miner.md row, but the offer text 78195 reads 'Pinkelug and I have put in a good word for you, but Snorg is in charge', which means the speaker is someone other than Pinkelug and other than Snorg. The speaker's npc_id is not in the pack, so the giver stays Pinkelug from the record only. The critique's suggestion that Snorg is the giver is not supported: the 78195 wording is third-person about Snorg.
Previous quest 'Miner: Speed Smelting' (3100026) has no live client title (see record 3100026 and Miner.md row 25), so the predecessor link is unverified in client text.
Rewards are not in the locale file or in any source in the pack; the list is empty.
The 'mine' step is a gather step, but the client does not say whether the moonstone is mined into the quest or bought. Kept as collect then deliver.
locale:141301 ('Still haven't delivered any freshly mined moonstone') may be a repeat reminder and is not used as a stage.
Snorg's npc_id 9000000470 comes from the repo (briarwood.json:62196). It is the giver of 3100028, not of this quest, so it is not used as this quest's giver.

quest.title: Ninja: Silence is Golden... and Deadly

quest_answer.zone: Lakeshore (giver); stealth stops in Seaside, Shrouded Glade and Snowhill; final stop in Blackspore

line.name: Ninja (Ty, Lakeshore) entry line, Ninja.md row E4
previous: Ninja: Super Star (guide order, Ninja.md row E3; the record's engine gate is 3110002 Ninja: Stolen Away, which the guide places at E2)

objectives.text: Speak to Brendan in Seaside to learn secrets of stealth.
Speak to Kosha in Shrouded Glade to learn secrets of stealth.
Speak to Tanda T. Toes in Snowhill to learn secrets of stealth.
objectives.target: Tanda T. Toes (Snowhill), npc key not bound

objectives.text: Return to Chloe in Blackspore

rewards.value: No confirmed reward. The guide lists the Amateur Ninja Blade as retired and no longer obtainable, so it is not a live reward. Coins and XP are unknown in the guide.

open: Stop order conflict: the record lists Brendan, Kosha, Chloe, then Ty (90402). The guide and intro text put Tanda T. Toes (90421, Snowhill) among the teachers and Chloe last. The answer follows the guide order. Tanda has no bound npc key, so the record's objective array needs a key or a substitution before it can be wired.

Prerequisite: the record gates on 3110002 (Stolen Away), but the guide places Super Star directly before this quest. Both are kept. The 3110002 gate is an engine field, not a sourced story predecessor.

Ty turn-in: 90402 ('Return to Ty in Lakeshore') is a client string, but no client source orders it as a step. The record's fourth talk step is therefore unconfirmed. The intro points to Chloe after the lessons.
NPC keys 9500000561 (Brendan), 9500000697 (Kosha) and 9000000047 (Chloe) are reconstructed bindings. Tanda's key is unknown. Chloe's name locale id was not found.
Rewards: none confirmed. The record's 5 coins and 20 Ninja job XP are reconstructed fallbacks with no sourced payout, so they are not listed as facts.
Dialog: no confirmed offer, progress or complete line. 78848 is an objective text, and 78851 is tagged quest_dialog from Lakeshore but is not confirmed as the completion line.
Level gate and in-play reachability are unknown.

objectives.text: As part of your ninja training, Chloe has asked you to defeat the denizens of the Cracked Claw Caverns of Blackspore.

open: The earlier talk objective 'Return to Chloe in Blackspore' is dropped. Locale 90450 ('Return to Chloe in Blackspore') and 90451 ('Return to Chloe for further instructions and training.') do exist as quest_objective strings, with hint 'Chloe' and no quest title. Nothing ties them to Strike from the Shadows, and the Mudshell.md:74 sequence is a separate observation. Attribution is unknown, so the step is not included. The earlier 'no client string' claim was wrong and has been withdrawn.

Kill target and count are unsettled. Candidates are encounter string 30439 ('Complete the Cracked Claw Caverns encounter.') and boss name 'Cracked Claw' (76410). Neither is tied to this quest, so the target is null and the objective is not wireable as is.
Whether the giver is Chloe or Ty is unresolved: the NPC list and wiki say Chloe, while 78852 points back to Lakeshore. The guide's giver locale id is unverified, so giver locale_id is null.
The previous and next links (3110004 and 3110006) hold only if this is a single-stage Blackspore quest. That is unsettled, so do not treat them as final.
No offer dialog string or rewards were found for this quest in the client, guide, video note or record. This does not prove there are none.
No wiki or article page confirms the quest.

line.name: Ninja job questline (Ty, then Sakka), Band 3

objectives.text: Ty in Lakeshore has challenged you to demonstrate your speed in a fast-paced foot race.

open: Chain order is unsettled. The guide table and our record put Idol Conversation (3110017) directly after Burst of Speed. The Walking the Path text (78884/78886) sends the player to Sakka, and Idol Conversation is Sakka's quest (78890), so Walking the Path likely sits between them. I could not confirm this from client order alone. The next link is set to Walking the Path, but Idol Conversation may be the true next after it; a builder must confirm.
Walking the Path has no record and no numeric id. Its title is locale 78885; its ucdt/ugdt ids are in the guide only and were not re-verified here.
The race is descriptive only. No client line that I could confirm is hint-tied to 78881 gives a finish condition, count, timer or reward. 93508, 90564 and 101505 are unmatched candidates.
No reward data in client, wiki or articles. min_level is unknown; 'level 10 to 15' is a guide band, not a verified gate.
The previous link (3110015) rests on guide row order and the existing record prerequisite; the client has no prerequisite field.

Critique 2 (line.next = Idol Conversation) was accepted in part: Walking the Path is now the next link, and Idol Conversation is noted as the probable follower. Critique on objectives: 90564 and 101505 are removed from objectives and kept as unmatched candidates; 93508 is added as a candidate.

q3120004.title: Pet Tutorial: Training

line.name: Pet Tutorial (Pet Trainer job unlock; three per-trainer variants)

objectives.text: Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the Training pet tutorial.

open: Structure: the three trainer variants (141498 Majorie/Cobblestone Village, 141510 Zachery/Stillwater Crossing, 141504 Mercy Merrywings/Highroad Junction) are alternative branches of one tutorial. The record as keyed is a combined record. A builder should split it into three records, each with its own giver, zone and objective, and I did not invent new record ids. Until then the only objective kept is the generic 141526.

Giver: 9000000452 is unresolved in the repo, so name and locale id stay null. Majorie's locale id 78658 and Mercy Merrywings's 103758 come from the reviewer's notes and were not re-verified here, so I left them out.
Zone is null for the combined record because the variants sit in three zones.

Previous and next are empty. The earlier answer's 'Pet Tutorial: Happiness' and 'Pet Trainer: Speak Up!' links had no source in the pack, and the wiki page gives no sequence. Same-giver record 3120003 ('Pet Tutorial: Happiness') is the only sourced neighbour, and it is not confirmed as the predecessor.
Zachery's completion line (141553) and Mercy Merrywings's (141540) were not verified by id. The Training progress dialog was not found.
Reward: no reward text found. The Pet Trainer Diploma (4273516526) is unconfirmed and not listed.

line.name: Pet Trainer common trainer series (after the pet tutorials, before Pet Trainer: To Sanctuary!)

objectives.text: Use the trick game to train your pet to do the trick "Speak".

open: Giver unresolved: 9000000368 covers Zachery (Stillwater Crossing), Majorie (Cobblestone Village) or Mercy Merrywings (Highroad Junction); no client line ties this quest to one, so name, locale and zone stay null. Same placeholder is the giver of Pet Trainer: To Sanctuary! (3120006).

Previous: the tutorial chain is linear in the wiki order (Basics, Happiness, Training), so Pet Tutorial: Training is the direct predecessor. The strict gate (which tutorial must be complete) is not confirmed by a prerequisite table; the client has no prerequisite table we could read.

Target 'Speak' is the trick word from locale:90020 and locale:90018. Earlier candidate locale:22714 is FLAGGED as a single-word fragment and is dropped as evidence. Trick id 3543896538 (guide row 179) is client-only and not wired here.
Objective kind: the client gives no objective type; 'minigame' is inferred from 'use the trick game'. No progress dialog identified.
No reward found in client or guide; rewards left empty, not inferred.

Speak with Enve LeStamp in Seaside.

open: Giver conflict: the record binds 9000000079 (Enaine), the wiki says Enaine, and the client hand-off and NPC name point to Enve LeStamp (117342). The record should be changed to 9000000080, but that id is sourced to the Autopilot note, not to this quest's own text.
Title status: 117306 is flagged duplicate of 117313 ("It's A Breeze!"). Which string is the live title is not settled, and no not_live flag is present on either.
Collect target: the mail-collection target is not named in the client text. 'Seaside Mail Sorting' (3188234607) is a guide candidate marked unconfirmed.

Minigame attribution: 117317 'Complete the Invitation Investigation minigame' shares the It's A Breeze! hint, but the guide (Postman.md:99) places Invitation Investigation (3833440476) under Invitation Only. It may belong to the next quest.
Completion dialog 117308 is tagged with this quest's hint, but its wording refers to invitations. Probable only.

Line links: previous 'Postman: And the Winner Is...' and next 'Postman: Achieve Level 10' rest on guide row order alone. Row 12 is unplaced, the video puts Level 10 just before Invitation Only, and the earlier answer's 'next: none' on the previous quest contradicts its link. Both are left empty here as unproven.
Offer dialog: none confirmed. 117305 is a referral line from another NPC.
Rewards: no source names any reward for this quest.
Quest id 3130016 is a batch key from the guide, not a server-confirmed id.

q3130019.title: Postman: Where's the Sasparilla?

line.name: Postman line (guide band 3, Seaside, row 16)

objectives.text: Find what happened to the Sweetwater Sasparilla.

open: Giver is unresolved. The record's npc_id 9000000079 is Enaine in seaside.json, but the giver dossier calls that binding a mis-binding. The wiki and guide name Enaine as giver, while the client speaker in the sibling lines is Enve LeStamp (locale 117342, also in 130183 and 130190). The 9000000080 candidate is tagged reconstructed_from_job_reference and is not a firm binding. The builder must check the live NPC table before wiring a giver.

Talk step: locale 130199 'Talk to Postchug Runalug' and 130217 'Talk to Postchug Runalug in Wugachug' are in the client, but they sit in the sibling cluster 130197-130200 (title 'Where's the Sasparilla?', not 130193) and 130217 sits in the Postchug cluster. Neither is confirmed as this quest's step. The guide's talk line 1317516993 is †. Not wired.

Sasparilla Sprint minigame: the guide's line 2215167782 is †, and the client minigame wording is locale 130213 'Complete the Sasparilla Sprint minigame', which sits in the Jug Clean Up cluster (130211-130214). It is not wired here as this quest's objective.

Completion text: 1865585004 'Hurray! You saved the day!...' is a guide id with no mapped locale id in the pack, so dialog.complete stays null. 130195 is the mid-quest ransack line, not confirmed as the completion.
Offer 130192 has no speaker in the client text. It is a candidate, since the guide marks the matching line †.
Rewards are unknown; no reward data is in the pack.

Previous link: the guide places 'Postman: Achieve Level 10' (row 14) before Invitation Only, so the true predecessor may be Achieve Level 10. Invitation Only is kept as the guide's direct predecessor.
Record 3130019 is a stable batch key, not a confirmed server quest id. The guide's hash cells (1960073937, 2073355985) are not locale ids and are not used.
Title choice: 130197 'Where's the Sasparilla?' is a separate Wugachug title and is not confirmed as this quest's title.

Builders should wire the level-15 gate as the condition. The Band 4 order is recorded here as ordering only, not a hard quest prerequisite.

Postman: Achieve Level 10 (387935) is Band 3 at Seaside, before Band 4 in the guide. Whether it is a hard gate is not established.

objectives.text: Coach Eddie wants you to beat the Snowhill Snowspurs again. This time, it's not a practice round. Watch out for "Iron Foot" Ronnie. He'll be out to get you!

Record 3150003 (Warrior's Rites) is a disabled stub with giver 9000000302 (Dewey) and prerequisite 3150002. The guide places Morninglory as its giver, so that stub needs correction before the chain can be closed.

Sword-test objective 22581 has no client target or completion id. The Steele dialog implies a practice-dummy step, but the server cannot complete it from the data we have. It is kept as a display-only 'other' objective and the build should not expect a completion for it.

Rewards are unknown. Warrior.md gives W4 rewards as 'unknown', and no client or wiki source gives coins or XP. The 5-coin and 25-XP values in the previous record are reconstructed fallbacks, not evidence, so they are removed here.

Dialog ids are not attributed to a speaker. 22585 ('Let's see how you perform with your weapon. Are you prepared?') and 22584 sit in this quest's cluster, but no speaker is confirmed, so offer/progress/complete stay null.
Steele's name id 47830 has a confirmed exact string, but its npc_name type was not checked. 434620 is a second exact match.
The end-text id is not known. The client title block has no end text id for this quest.

open: Giver: the offer line 70994 has no speaker tag. Steele is the repo record giver (9000000208) and the guide W7 row; the NPC name 'Steele' is confirmed at locale:47830, but the speaker link is not in the client. Sanctuary's Steele (NPC Id 33776) is not confirmed to match 9000000208.
Turn-in NPC: the completion line 70997 and the substitute line 71005 fit Tumbolina, and the guide's W8 is her quest, but no client tag confirms that Tumbolina is the completer.

Chain order: the guide lists W6 'Contract: Ready Your Weapon!' (3150006, repeatable, Caleb Sleepyswing) as 'after W5' with no fixed position relative to W7. Our record gives only 3150005 as prerequisite. Previous is therefore 3150005 by record; 3150006 may sit between W5 and W7 and is not confirmed as an immediate predecessor. Next 'Warrior: Distracted' rests on the guide's W8 row ('after W7') and the Merry Vale link.

Collect step: no client objective string says to pick up the weapons. The offer line 70994 asks for it, but it is dialog, not an objective, so no collect objective is listed. Guide objective ids are not client ids and were not used.
Reward: the substitute item is unnamed in client text, so it cannot be wired to an item id. Repo rewards are empty.
Weapon-crate strings shared with W20 (Steele is Useful) are attributed to both quests in the guide and were not used as evidence for W7 beyond 70996.
Our record's objectives and rewards are empty and enabled:false; the wiring still needs building from the objectives and dialog listed here.

line.name: Super Spooktacular (Halloween event) quest chain

objectives.text: Just to be on the safe side, Halloween Harry would like you to report Ethan's disappearance to General Glowlight in Sanctuary.

open: The speaker of locale:415314 is unnamed. I left dialog.offer null because the pack does not show whether it is the offer or a progress line. Harry is the likely speaker.

No completion or turn-in dialog for the General Glowlight step is in the pack, so the 'talk' kind is inferred from the objective wording ('report ... to General Glowlight'). It could be a deliver or talk step.

Location conflict: the wiki Super Spooktacular page and the repo NPC note (NPCs - Sanctuary.md:134) place Halloween Harry at Pixiewood Hills. The client quest tags say Sanctuary. I used Sanctuary for the quest zone, and the NPC's own location is unresolved.

General Glowlight's name id 7670 and Halloween Harry's name id 415047 come from the previous answer and the legacy repo data. I did not re-confirm them through the locale tool. The repo note gives different name hashes (Glowlight 3346465024, Harry 3017163840), which I have not reconciled.
No rewards were found in client text, wiki or repo.
No quest record exists for this quest, so record_id is null. The next link 'A Trip to the Swamp' is client-real and wiki-listed, but has no record on our side either.

npc_id is unresolved. Tiger's name id 2807361043 is shared across Seaside, Sanctuary, Blackspore and Snowhill NPC files, so no Seaside-specific key can be set from the evidence. A builder should pick the Seaside spawn from the luau event system.

Repeatability is wiki/repo-only (repeatable) and no client string confirms it.

Reward: 'Luau Party Favor' (4548) is a name only. Its link to A Luau is wiki-only, and quantity and item id are unknown. The wiki image petpartyfavoricon.png is not used as evidence. The repo's Pets.md ties 'Pet Party Favor' to Party for Pets, a separate quest.

'Obtain a pet' (422881) is tagged to a pet-party objective (422880) but is a separate quest, not listed as a sibling. open: Giver not confirmed: offer 413095 has no named speaker. Sadie is inferred from wording and the repo dossier (row 73), and npc_id is not settled because no quest record or NPC id for Sadie was matched here.

Find Silverspark (quest_title 413229; objectives 413228, 413230, 413390) is not placed. 413230 says Sadie directed the player to Silverspark, so it may come before this quest as a stage, or be the same stage as objective 413097. Previous is left as only Distracting Druids until the order is settled.
Talk to Sadie (413233) has no matching quest answer in this chain; its placement as a next quest is unsettled and removed. 413234 is a Silverspark-side line that may belong to a later stage.
Client tags say Pony Vale for 413095-413098, while the objective names Unicorn Forest. Zone is given as Unicorn Forest from the objective text; the tag conflict is noted here.
Turn-in NPC not confirmed. Completion 413098 has no speaker; Silverspark is the likely recipient because the objective targets her.
Progress dialog and reward are not found in any source. Later Silverspark steps (Yarith's Remedy 413245/413246, Return to Silverspark 413549/413550) are not linked here and need their own records.

Locale 439878 and 439879 resolve in the lookup tool. The locale tool also returns them. Earlier citations claiming they do not resolve are wrong.
The giver name locale (440141 from the community file) does not resolve in the client table; the name is supported by the wiki and Npcs.json only.

open: No quest record exists; record_id is null. The repo hashes (ucdt 105669541, ugdt 1563769774) are unverified and not used.

Fairy Informant meeting: 74279 implies an informant step before the Den, but no objective string for that meeting was found, so it is not listed as an objective. Its position is unknown.

Scout target 'rainbow stage' has no place locale id; it is text-derived from 74276.

The Den of Secrets boss step (Mayor McFairy, 115678/115679) is not an objective of this quest in the strings found; the wiki says the Mayor is an enemy in the Den during this quest, so a boss fight may be part of it, unsettled. Locale 441741 is dialog text, not the Mayor's name, so it is not used.
Rewards: none found in the pack or client strings.
Whether draft 74277 is a cut or a rename of this quest is not settled.

whungry-hungry-troll.title: Hungry Hungry Troll

objectives.text: Zwargug wants you to get him some food from Diggy in Seaside.
Diggy can be found at the Ocean Treasures Cafe in Seaside.
Talk to Diggy
Get Zwargug in Seaside some food from Diggy! He's hungry!
Return to Zwargug

open: Treated as one quest: 101431-101437 and the 'Zwargug's Food' set 101439-101446 describe the same errand. The hint label differs, and no second title string exists, so a split into two quests is possible but unproven.
Zwargug's NPC id is unverified. The earlier 9500000646 came from a Legacy reference (Npcs.json Id=1929) that was not checked here, so npc_id is left null.
Ocean Treasures Cafe has no client locale id; the repo's 1556595973 is unchecked. target_locale_id stays null.
Rewards are not in the client text. The souffle in 101442 is handed to Zwargug, so it is not treated as a reward. Coins and items are unknown.
Diggy's cooking step (pan minigame, repo seaside.json:12150) is not confirmed as a step of this quest.
Previous and next quests in the Seaside line are unknown. Repo title id 254473930 has no client match and is not used.
The hint 'Zwargug's Food' suggests the quest may have an internal name different from its title; no client string under that name exists.

open: The retail quiz is three questions (Q1 23057, Q2 23063, Q3 23069 progress line) with pass/fail lines 23061/23073 and objective lines 23052/23080/23086; correct answers and scoring are not recovered, so the server models only the talk step. The quiz is an approximation.

Locale 23057, 23063, 23052, 23080, 23086, 23061, 23073 were not re-fetched in this pass; they come from the prior answer's citations.

wsoftening-the-stone.title: Softening the Stone

line.name: Festival of Hearts (Version 7.0) Merry Vale quest chain

objectives.text: Use the love potions Cudip stashed around Merry Vale; using them gives you a magic bow and arrows.
Hit Stone Heart with the potion-dipped arrows to weaken him.
Once he's defeated, find his hiding place and convince him to talk.

open: No server record; record_id is null. Server prev/next links are unverified.
Giver locale id 426988 (cited earlier) was not re-verified in this pass; giver npc_id is unknown (repo gives only name hashes).

The 'find his hiding place' step: the repo Hideaway note cites locale 2060386145 for 'Find Stone Heart in his hideaway and speak to him.' (locale 427471 has that text), but 427471's hint is tagged Heartbreaker in the client pack, so attribution to this quest is not confirmed. Kept as 'other' with no separate proof.
Dialog offer/progress/complete ids unconfirmed. 427159 is a Softening-tagged quest_dialog line but no source ties it to a turn-in step.
Rewards: none sourced. The bow and arrows come from using potions (a mechanic), not a reward.
Arrow-hit count unknown (61/100 is a video frame counter only).

Next link 'Stone Heart's Hideaway' is a separate repeatable quest from Cudip, not the same quest. Sleeping Pixie and Hideaway records on the other side must be checked: the earlier answer's claim that Hideaway's previous is Sleeping Pixie conflicts with repo Hideaway note line 32, which names Softening the Stone.
Potent Love Potion giver 'Talespinner Yvelle' comes from the wiki Festival of Hearts page; the repo row (NPCs - Merry Vale.md:207) also cites wiki only, so it rests on that single wiki source.

line.name: Shrouded Gloam invasion (Shrouded Glade finale)

objectives.text: Reach the third escort point
Defeat Gloam constructs

rewards.value: No coin or item amount found in the client; reward text only (the druids thank the player and remember Gus of the Sunstone Dwarves)

open: Previous is weakly sourced. 'Report to Sunspark' is the last step of the druid arc in the wiki order (repo note line 200), but no server link or script confirms it leads here. Payback (dwarf arc end) is not added because the repo note says it leads to the druid arc when not done, so it may not be a predecessor. Backs Against the Wall and Trapped and Alone are the Sunspark openers of each arc, not direct predecessors, so they are dropped. Critique 2 is right on this point and critique 1 is not.

Conflict on the finale boss: the client tags 'Defeat Gloam constructs' (438262) to this title. The repo note at NPCs - Shrouded Glade.md:202 says 'finale vs General Drahk' and cites 'Do you want to face General Drahk again in the final battle?' (1046625125), but I could not confirm 1046625125 in the client text here, so it is unverified. The wiki says General Drahk appears during this quest, which supports the note. 'Defeat General Drahk' (438273) is tagged to Save Arch Druid Camellia, so it is excluded. Both fights may be in this quest; the objective list is incomplete until the client's objective order is checked.

Conflict on 438268 'Join Captain Sunspark for the final attack against the Gloam in Shrouded Glade': the repo json (shrouded_glade.json:5137) gives it to this quest, but the client tags 438268-438270 to the group 'Final Attack on the Gloam'. Excluded here as unresolved; the group may be a sibling or staging step.
The escort objective's kind 'go' and count are inferred from the wording 'third escort point'. No escort NPC or script was found.
Captain Sunspark's npc_id and name locale id are unresolved; repo ids 2707872564 and 3604610022 are not verified as client locale ids.
dialog.complete 438261 is a quest_reward line, so it is a likely completion text but not confirmed.
Next is unknown; the wiki order shows no successor, so next is left empty as 'unknown' rather than confirmed as the end of the line.
No record id exists; a new record would be needed.

wurgent-missive.title: Urgent Missive

line.name: Gorg's Briarwood camp quests (first Gorg cluster after the maze)

objectives.text: Gorg has received urgent communications and needs help spreading the news around.
Use the sack to Gorg's left to launch the Urgent Missive minigame. Complete the game.
Complete the Urgent Missive Minigame in Briarwood.
Find Snorg (deliver the Urgent Missive to Snorg; alternate single step: talk to Snorg and Sergeant Cargug and give them the Urgent Missive, 36441).
Find Sergeant Cargug and speak to him to deliver the Urgent Missive.
Return to Gorg.
Inform Gorg of your success.

rewards.value: No coin, item or xp reward found in client text; completion line only says 'You have the makings of a good soldier! Fast and disciplined.'

open: Delivery order is unsourced: 36441 reads as one talk-and-give step to both Snorg and Sergeant Cargug, while 36442 'Find Snorg' and 36446 'Find Sergeant Cargug' suggest two stops. Both are listed; the order is unconfirmed. The critique's suggested 36445 text is a separate string and was not re-verified here.
Chugawug delivery variant (36443 and the second variant 430930) is unplaced; left out of the required path.
36494 'Complete the Urgent Missive minigame' is an alternate wording of the minigame step (36493) and is not required separately.
Progress dialog 36480 'You bring news from Gorg? Excellent!' is tagged to this hint but its speaker and stage are unverified, so progress is left null.

Zone: client 36493 says 'in Briarwood', but client 16139 and the wiki Gorg page place Gorg's camp in northern or southern Bristlewood. The repo note (NPCs - Briarwood.md:327) records the conflict as unresolved. Briarwood is used because it is the client-stated minigame location.
Repeatable: wiki says non-repeatable; 36505 ('keep trying to get better times') hints at replay. Not set.

Server npc_id is unknown; the earlier 9500000142 key is only a reconstructed key (repo notes/Autopilot/T317.md:247 names it as a third-person reference), so it is not used. Offer dialog line not found.

Chain position: previous and next are unordered within the Gorg cluster (Cut the Vines, Spinnerette, Stopping an Infiltration, Take the Fight to Them); no source orders Urgent Missive relative to them.
No quest record exists; record_id is null. Locale 36492, 36496 and 36497 were cited from the prior pack and were not re-queried individually here.
